scope: FY2027 House 3rd-reading DPWH project allocations matched to Senate-provided HGAB POWs.
method: Exact normalized POW title matches only. The comparison uses I. TOTAL ESTIMATED COST from the first page. When the I amount is unreadable or fails to reconcile, I is calculated from the printed G Total Construction Cost (D+E+F) plus H Engineering and Administrative Overhead (EAO). The first-page A+B+C summary is supporting evidence only and is not added to a bill subtotal. Repeated copies with the same HGAB file code are deduplicated. Projects with multiple distinct matched POW codes are shown as review cases and excluded from aggregate totals.
limitations: POW printed category totals are estimates, not actual expenditures, contract prices, or proof of completed work.

The comparison target is I. TOTAL ESTIMATED COST, which includes G Total Construction Cost (D+E+F) and H Engineering and Administrative Overhead (EAO). A 100% A+B+C summary or D+E+F bill subtotal alone is not the comparison amount.

I amounts are read from the printed first-page total. Where that amount is obscured or its extracted text does not reconcile, the value is reconstructed only when printed G and H amounts are both available. These cases are identified in each POW detail.
Two HGAB file codes have different totals across distinct source PDF versions; those codes remain review cases and are not selected for aggregate comparison.
Allocation and POW estimate can cover different scope, phases, or cost bases. A difference is a review signal, not an overrun, saving, or finding of wrongdoing.
Multiple distinct matched POW codes and conflicting parses of one code are not summed or arbitrarily selected; they are excluded from aggregate comparison pending review.
No exact-title match or no recovered summary does not prove that a POW is absent.

flagging.basis: directional difference between POW I. TOTAL ESTIMATED COST (As Submitted) and HGAB allocation
flagging.comparison: Strictly greater than thresholds. If estimated cost is above allocation, the row is Red flag only; if allocation is above estimate by more than ₱500,000, it is Double red flag.

labels.double_red_flag: Double red flag (allocation exceeds estimate by more than ₱500,000)
labels.red_flag: Red flag (difference above ₱50,000; above-allocation estimates remain red)

sourceSnapshot.note: Pre-OCR-rescan table matching the supplied screenshot; compatible rescan estimates are added, and contradictory rescan candidates are retained for review.

rescanReconciliation.policy: Use the pre-rescan table as the comparison baseline. Preserve its known estimates when the rescan conflicts. Add a previously missing rescan estimate only when the rescan marks it comparable and a supporting A+B+C subtotal is recovered; keep unsupported candidates separate for source-page review. User-directed rule: retain original values and reject rescan candidates when the original absolute allocation-versus-I gap is under ₱1,000.
